svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a strip of 25 mm aluminised blanket 96 mm wide and 1,010 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: long, foil outward; wear gloves, a dust mask and glasses.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bind both long edges with aluminised tape.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: wrap it round the canner wall from 80 mm above the base to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 30 mm below the rim, butt the ends and tape the joint.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hold it with two stainless strap clamps, 12 mm from each edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The lowest 80 mm of wall and the base stay bare and black.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it stops below the handles and clears the ring by 5 mm.
